scope: Read-only editorial and structural audit of all 41 current canonical narratives, seven-part site sequence and shared book narrative plan. No public edits/builds/publication.
method: Read all narrative bodies in order; repaired tool-output truncation with targeted rereads. Spot-checked retained evidence only for identified inference issues. No fresh independent full-film viewing, full-book reading or exhaustive external source verification. Website maintenance prose may be renderer-suppressed; it is not counted as a new live regression.
authority: Independent AI editorial review, not human approval.

keep: Latest 1298-word introduction and user-preferred full portrait; core personal question now clear.
Seven-part route: literary/broadcast world; music; films/makers; memory; recent stories; changing screens; economics/future.
Named recollections and actual roles, especially women’s publishing, producing, mentoring and independent music ambitions.
Precise award/selection/jury, original/dubbed language and cinema-versus-health-programme distinctions.
Ordinary unified numbered source/image notes; do not restore a separate image-credit chapter.
synthesis.main_problem: The collection explains its method of noticing collaborators after showing collaborators. Repeated invitations, credit explanations and next-work conclusions make unrelated lives sound alike. Reduce interpretive reprises before cutting specific testimony, names or source limits.
synthesis.sequence: Keep film-to-maker pairs and the DAMaN cluster. The 41-part sequence is intentionally thematic, not chronological. Offer the four existing short reading paths before the long sequence; the audience should not need to finish seven biographies to reach a film. Gopal→AIR and music hub→four profiles work if duplicate facts are brief. For the book, continue using short overview plus companion survey rather than forcing its approximately 5800-word source body upfront.
priorities: Correct guide credit extension and Aadim literary-adaptation inference.
Remove repeated callout and adjacent-profile recaps.
Move or isolate count/table/reference detail rather than delete truthful qualifications.
Make final invitations concrete and varied; reserve detailed paid-development programme for futures.
Only then research richer craft/participant evidence where it is genuinely missing.
synthesis.fairness: Do not erase DAMaN criticisms, television labour insecurity, constrained access, gender barriers or missing-film uncertainty to create an upbeat narrative. Hope is strongest when a named contribution and an attainable next action are visible. Avoid making prestige or one genre the test of worth.
